name: piper_status
description: Current measured state and adapter limits; no motion.

name: piper_stream
description: Read the continuous RGB recording as a contact sheet. Inspection only; use piper_observe for metric depth and action boundaries.

name: piper_check_path
description: Pure sampled collision and LEFT flange workspace preflight. workspace_check uses the same 41 FK samples and bounds as dispatch; require workspace_clear AND cad_clear. Installed 170mm LEFT finger envelopes; optional environment boxes in dual_base_link. No SDK or motion; empty environment is NOT scene clearance.

name: piper_observe
description: Current three cameras. Head FFS is the default depth; explicitly request depth_cameras=[left] for wrist optical depth without hand-eye. Full saved image coordinates in meta.json; preview downscaled.

name: piper_pixel_to_position
description: Saved full-resolution pixels to metres. Head defaults to provisional left_base_link; LEFT requires output_frame=camera_optical and cannot command a robot target. Does not expire historical analysis or grant motion.

name: piper_fk
description: Pure CAD flange FK, six radians. Base frame is the selected arm base, not dual_base_link; no calibrated grasp TCP.

name: piper_solve_ik
description: Pure MoveIt2 KDL full-pose LEFT flange IK; optional explicit seed for offline use. No approximate solution, no hardware motion, no scene path certification.

name: piper_move_pose
description: Move LEFT flange to a left_base_link pose using KDL and the existing checked joint trajectory. This is a joint-interpolated path, not a guaranteed straight TCP path. Max 400mm per call. Preserve orientation if omitted.

duration_s.description: Omit to let the owner choose a duration within its speed/acceleration limits.

observe_after.description: After confirmed arrival, save and return current camera images in this call. An observation_error preserves the successful motion receipt: observe again, never replay the motion to recover images.

name: piper_move_joints
description: Move six LEFT joints, preserving right arm and both jaws. Max60deg change; existing owner validates path, speed and measured arrival.

duration_s.description: Omit to let the owner choose a duration within its speed/acceleration limits.

observe_after.description: After confirmed arrival, save and return current camera images in this call. An observation_error preserves the successful motion receipt: observe again, never replay the motion to recover images.

name: piper_gripper
description: LEFT full jaw gap 0..75mm in metres; max10mm change per call. Arrival is not grasp/contact proof. Right gripper is unavailable.

duration_s.description: Omit to let the owner choose a duration within its speed/acceleration limits.

observe_after.description: After confirmed arrival, save and return current camera images in this call. An observation_error preserves the successful motion receipt: observe again, never replay the motion to recover images.

name: piper_hold
description: At tool-call boundaries verify rest or request owner cancellation. Serialized MCP cannot interrupt another running tool: use the independent operator stop or physical emergency stop.
